description: This bar chart compares the performance scores of two models, “RedWhale (our)” and “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 (base)”, across multiple evaluation benchmarks and their overall average. The horizontal axis lists the evaluation benchmarks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the performance score, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.10. Each benchmark has two bars: a dark purple bar labeled “RedWhale (our)” and a light blue bar labeled “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 (base)”, with the light blue bar consistently being taller than the dark purple bar. The specific scores are labeled above each bar: for PT-EVAL, RedWhale scores 0.42 and EEVE scores 0.46; for KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale scores 0.71 and EEVE scores 0.74; for KoBEST-CP, RedWhale scores 0.50 and EEVE scores 0.54; for KoBEST-HS, RedWhale scores 0.69 and EEVE scores 0.73; for KoBEST-SN, RedWhale scores 0.57 and EEVE scores 0.61; and for AVG, RedWhale scores 0.52 and EEVE scores 0.56. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each benchmark and are not sorted.
